ayahs.arabicText: الٓمّٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: اَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ اَنْ یُّتْرَكُوْۤا اَنْ یَّقُوْلُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا وَ هُمْ لَا یُفْتَنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do people think that they will be let go merely by saying: “We believe,” and that they will not be tested,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَلَیَعْلَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْنَ صَدَقُوْا وَ لَیَعْلَمَنَّ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: for We indeed tested those who went before them? Allah will most certainly ascertain those who spoke the truth and those who lied.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِیْنَ یَعْمَلُوْنَ السَّیِّاٰتِ اَنْ یَّسْبِقُوْنَا١ؕ سَآءَ مَا یَحْكُمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do the evil-doers suppose that they will get the better of Us? How evil is their judgement!

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ كَانَ یَرْجُوْا لِقَآءَ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ لَاٰتٍ١ؕ وَ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْعَلِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: Let him who looks forward to meeting Allah know that Allah's appointed term will surely come to pass. He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ جَاهَدَ فَاِنَّمَا یُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَنِیٌّ عَنِ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Whosoever strives (in the cause of Allah) does so to his own good. Surely Allah stands in no need of anyone in the whole Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَیِّاٰتِهِمْ وَ لَنَجْزِیَنَّهُمْ اَحْسَنَ الَّذِیْ كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those who believe and do good deeds, We shall cleanse them of their evil deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَصَّیْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَیْهِ حُسْنًا١ؕ وَ اِنْ جَاهَدٰكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِیْ مَا لَیْسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا١ؕ اِلَیَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَاُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents, but if they exert pressure on you to associate with Me in My Divinity any that you do not know (to be My associate), do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I shall let you know all that you have done.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِی الصّٰلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for those who believed and acted righteously, We shall certainly admit them among the righteous.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ یَّقُوْلُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ فَاِذَاۤ اُوْذِیَ فِی اللّٰهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ وَ لَئِنْ جَآءَ نَصْرٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ لَیَقُوْلُنَّ اِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ١ؕ اَوَ لَیْسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِیْ صُدُوْرِ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Among people there are some who say: “We believe in Allah.” But when such a person is made to endure suffering in Allah's cause, he reckons the persecution he suffers at the hands of people as though it is a chastisement from Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, the same person will say “We were with you.” Does Allah not know whatever is in the hearts of the people of the world?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَیَعْلَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ لَیَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنٰفِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah will surely ascertain who are the believers and who are the hypocrites.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِلَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّبِعُوْا سَبِیْلَنَا وَ لْنَحْمِلْ خَطٰیٰكُمْ١ؕ وَ مَا هُمْ بِحٰمِلِیْنَ مِنْ خَطٰیٰهُمْ مِّنْ شَیْءٍ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ لَكٰذِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers say to the believers: “Follow our way and we will carry the burden of your sins.” (They say so even though) they are not going to carry any part of their sins. Surely they are lying.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَیَحْمِلُنَّ اَثْقَالَهُمْ وَ اَثْقَالًا مَّعَ اَثْقَالِهِمْ١٘ وَ لَیُسْئَلُنَّ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوْا یَفْتَرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: They will certainly carry their own burdens and other burdens besides their own. They will assuredly be called to account on the Day of Resurrection concerning the fabrications which they contrived.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖ فَلَبِثَ فِیْهِمْ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ اِلَّا خَمْسِیْنَ عَامًا١ؕ فَاَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوْفَانُ وَ هُمْ ظٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We did indeed send Noah to his people and he lived among them a thousand years save fifty. Eventually the Flood overtook them while they were engaged in wrongdoing.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَنْجَیْنٰهُ وَ اَصْحٰبَ السَّفِیْنَةِ وَ جَعَلْنٰهَاۤ اٰیَةً لِّلْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then We rescued Noah together with the people in the Ark and made it (that is, the Ark) a lesson for all people.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اتَّقُوْهُ١ؕ ذٰلِكُمْ خَیْرٌ لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We sent Abraham and he said to his people: “Serve Allah and fear Him. This is better for you if you only knew.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَوْثَانًا وَّ تَخْلُقُوْنَ اِفْكًا١ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ لَا یَمْلِكُوْنَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَابْتَغُوْا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ الرِّزْقَ وَ اعْبُدُوْهُ وَ اشْكُرُوْا لَهٗ١ؕ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those that you worship instead of Allah are merely idols, and you are simply inventing lies (about them). Indeed those whom you worship beside Allah have no power to provide you with any sustenance. So seek your sustenance from Allah and serve only Him and give thanks to Him alone. It is to Him that you will be sent back.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ تُكَذِّبُوْا فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ اُمَمٌ مِّنْ قَبْلِكُمْ١ؕ وَ مَا عَلَى الرَّسُوْلِ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: And if you give the lie (to the Messenger), then many nations before you also gave the lie (to their Messengers). The Messenger is charged with no other duty than to deliver the Message in clear terms.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا كَیْفَ یُبْدِئُ اللّٰهُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ یُعِیْدُهٗ١ؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ یَسِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Have they never observed how Allah creates for the first time and then repeats it? Indeed (to repeat the creation of a thing) is even easier for Allah (than creating it for the first time).

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ سِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَیْفَ بَدَاَ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ اللّٰهُ یُنْشِئُ النَّشْاَةَ الْاٰخِرَةَ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌۚ
ayahs.translation: Say: “Go about the earth and see how He created for the first time, and then Allah will recreate life.” Surely, Allah has power over everything.

ayahs.arabicText: یُعَذِّبُ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ وَ یَرْحَمُ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ١ۚ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُقْلَبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He chastises whom He will and forgives whom He will. To Him all of you will be sent back.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِیْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ لَا فِی السَّمَآءِ١٘ وَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ وَّلِیٍّ وَّ لَا نَصِیْرٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: You cannot overpower Allah, neither on the earth nor in the heaven. None can protect you from Allah nor come to your aid against Him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَ لِقَآئِهٖۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ یَئِسُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَتِیْ وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieved in Allah's signs and in meeting Him, it is they who have despaired of My Mercy; it is they for whom a painful chastisement lies ahead.

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهٖۤ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ قَالُوا اقْتُلُوْهُ اَوْ حَرِّقُوْهُ فَاَنْجٰىهُ اللّٰهُ مِنَ النَّارِ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The people (of Abraham) had no other answer than to say: “Kill him or burn him.” But Allah delivered him from the fire. There are many Signs in this for those who believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ اِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَوْثَانًا١ۙ مَّوَدَّةَ بَیْنِكُمْ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ۚ ثُمَّ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ یَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَّ یَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا١٘ وَّ مَاْوٰىكُمُ النَّارُ وَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِیْنَۗۙ
ayahs.translation: He said: “You have taken up idols instead of Allah as a bond of love among yourselves in the present life, but on the Day of Resurrection you will disown and curse one another. Your refuge shall be the Fire, and none will come to your aid.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاٰمَنَ لَهٗ لُوْطٌ١ۘ وَ قَالَ اِنِّیْ مُهَاجِرٌ اِلٰى رَبِّیْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْحَكِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: Then did Lot believe him, and Abraham said: “I am emigrating unto my Lord. He is All-Powerful, All-Wise,”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَهَبْنَا لَهٗۤ اِسْحٰقَ وَ یَعْقُوْبَ وَ جَعَلْنَا فِیْ ذُرِّیَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَ الْكِتٰبَ وَ اٰتَیْنٰهُ اَجْرَهٗ فِی الدُّنْیَا١ۚ وَ اِنَّهٗ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and We bestowed upon him (offspring like) Isaac and Jacob, and bestowed prophethood and the Book on his descendants and granted him his reward in this world; he will certainly be among the righteous in the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لُوْطًا اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهٖۤ اِنَّكُمْ لَتَاْتُوْنَ الْفَاحِشَةَ١٘ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We sent Lot and he said to his people: “You commit the abomination that none in the world ever committed before you.

ayahs.arabicText: اَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَاْتُوْنَ الرِّجَالَ وَ تَقْطَعُوْنَ السَّبِیْلَ١ۙ۬ وَ تَاْتُوْنَ فِیْ نَادِیْكُمُ الْمُنْكَرَ١ؕ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهٖۤ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ قَالُوا ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: What! Do you go to men (to satisfy your lust), engage in highway robbery, and commit evil deeds in your gatherings?” Then they had no answer to offer other than to say: “Bring Allah's chastisement upon us if you are truthful.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِیْ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Lot said: “My Lord, aid me against these mischievous people.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَاۤ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرٰى١ۙ قَالُوْۤا اِنَّا مُهْلِكُوْۤا اَهْلِ هٰذِهِ الْقَرْیَةِ١ۚ اِنَّ اَهْلَهَا كَانُوْا ظٰلِمِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: When Our emissaries brought the good news to Abraham, and said (to him): “We are surely going to destroy the inhabitants of this city; its inhabitants are immersed in wrong-doing.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنَّ فِیْهَا لُوْطًا١ؕ قَالُوْا نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ فِیْهَا١٘ٙ لَنُنَجِّیَنَّهٗ وَ اَهْلَهٗۤ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهٗ١٘ۗ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغٰبِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Abraham said: “But Lot is there.” They replied: “We are well aware of those who are there. We shall save him and all his household except his wife.” His wife is among those who will stay behind.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّاۤ اَنْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوْطًا سِیْٓءَ بِهِمْ وَ ضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَّ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ وَ لَا تَحْزَنْ١۫ اِنَّا مُنَجُّوْكَ وَ اَهْلَكَ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغٰبِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: When Our emissaries came to Lot he was distressed and embarrassed on their account. They said: “Do not fear nor be distressed. We shall save you and all your household except your wife who is among those that will stay behind.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا مُنْزِلُوْنَ عَلٰۤى اَهْلِ هٰذِهِ الْقَرْیَةِ رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَفْسُقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We shall bring down upon the people of this city a scourge from the heaven because of their evildoing.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَاۤ اٰیَةًۢ بَیِّنَةً لِّقَوْمٍ یَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have left a vestige of it in that city as a Clear Sign for a people who use their reason.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِلٰى مَدْیَنَ اَخَاهُمْ شُعَیْبًا١ۙ فَقَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَ ارْجُوا الْیَوْمَ الْاٰخِرَ وَ لَا تَعْثَوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We sent to Midian their brother Shuayb. He said: “My people, serve Allah and look forward to the Last Day and do not go about the earth committing mischief.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِیْ دَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِیْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: But they denounced him as a liar. So a mighty earthquake overtook them, and by the morning they lay overturned in their houses.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عَادًا وَّ ثَمُوْدَاۡ وَ قَدْ تَّبَیَّنَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ مَّسٰكِنِهِمْ١۫ وَ زَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّیْطٰنُ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِیْلِ وَ كَانُوْا مُسْتَبْصِرِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And We destroyed Ad and Thamud, whose dwellings you have observed. Satan had embellished their deeds for them and had turned them away from the Right Path although they were a people of clear perception.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَارُوْنَ وَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هَامٰنَ١۫ وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ مُّوْسٰى بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا كَانُوْا سٰبِقِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And We destroyed Qarun (Korah) and Pharaoh and Haman. Moses came to them with Clear Signs but they waxed arrogant in the land although they could not have outstripped (Us).

ayahs.arabicText: فَكُلًّا اَخَذْنَا بِذَنْۢبِهٖ١ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَیْهِ حَاصِبًا١ۚ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ اَخَذَتْهُ الصَّیْحَةُ١ۚ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ١ۚ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ اَغْرَقْنَا١ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِیَظْلِمَهُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ كَانُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ یَظْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So We seized each for their sin. We let loose upon some a violent tornado with showers of stones; some were overtaken by a mighty Cry; some were caused to be swallowed up by the earth, and some We drowned. Allah would not wrong them, but it is they who wronged themselves.

ayahs.arabicText: مَثَلُ الَّذِیْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَوْلِیَآءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنْكَبُوْتِ١ۚۖ اِتَّخَذَتْ بَیْتًا١ؕ وَ اِنَّ اَوْهَنَ الْبُیُوْتِ لَبَیْتُ الْعَنْكَبُوْتِ١ۘ لَوْ كَانُوْا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The case of those who took others than Allah as their protectors is that of a spider who builds a house; but the frailest of all houses is the spider's house; if they only knew.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یَعْلَمُ مَا یَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ شَیْءٍ١ؕ وَ هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْحَكِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah knows fully what they call upon apart from Him. He is the Most Powerful, the Most Wise.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تِلْكَ الْاَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ١ۚ وَ مَا یَعْقِلُهَاۤ اِلَّا الْعٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: These are the parables that We set forth to make people understand. But only those endowed with knowledge will comprehend them.

ayahs.arabicText: خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Allah has created the heavens and the earth in Truth. Certainly there is a Sign in this for those who believe.

ayahs.arabicText: اُتْلُ مَاۤ اُوْحِیَ اِلَیْكَ مِنَ الْكِتٰبِ وَ اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ١ؕ اِنَّ الصَّلٰوةَ تَنْهٰى عَنِ الْفَحْشَآءِ وَ الْمُنْكَرِ١ؕ وَ لَذِكْرُ اللّٰهِ اَكْبَرُ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ یَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), recite the Book that has been revealed to you and establish Prayer. Surely Prayer forbids indecency and evil. And Allah's remembrance is of even greater merit. Allah knows all that you do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تُجَادِلُوْۤا اَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِیْ هِیَ اَحْسَنُ١ۖۗ اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْهُمْ وَ قُوْلُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِالَّذِیْۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْنَا وَ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْكُمْ وَ اِلٰهُنَا وَ اِلٰهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَّ نَحْنُ لَهٗ مُسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Argue not with the People of the Book except in the fairest manner, unless it be those of them that are utterly unjust. Say to them: “We believe in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to you. One is our God and your God; and we are those who submit ourselves to Him.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ اَنْزَلْنَاۤ اِلَیْكَ الْكِتٰبَ١ؕ فَالَّذِیْنَ اٰتَیْنٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ١ۚ وَ مِنْ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ مَنْ یُّؤْمِنُ بِهٖ١ؕ وَ مَا یَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اِلَّا الْكٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), thus have We bestowed the Book on you. So those on whom We had bestowed the Book before believe in it, and of these (Arabs) too a good many believe in it. It is none but the utter unbelievers who deny Our Signs.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كُنْتَ تَتْلُوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ مِنْ كِتٰبٍ وَّ لَا تَخُطُّهٗ بِیَمِیْنِكَ اِذًا لَّارْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), you did not recite any Book before, nor did you write it down with your hand; for then the votaries of falsehood would have had a cause for doubt.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ هُوَ اٰیٰتٌۢ بَیِّنٰتٌ فِیْ صُدُوْرِ الَّذِیْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ١ؕ وَ مَا یَجْحَدُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اِلَّا الظّٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But it is a set of Clear Signs in the hearts of those who have been endowed with knowledge. None except the utterly unjust will deny Our Signs.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا لَوْ لَاۤ اُنْزِلَ عَلَیْهِ اٰیٰتٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ١ؕ قُلْ اِنَّمَا الْاٰیٰتُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ وَ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: They say: “Why were Signs from his Lord not sent down upon him?” Say: “The Signs are only with Allah. As for me, I am no more than a plain warner.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَكْفِهِمْ اَنَّاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَیْكَ الْكِتٰبَ یُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَّ ذِكْرٰى لِقَوْمٍ یُّؤْمِنُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Does it not suffice for them (as a Sign) that We revealed to you the Book that is recited to them? Surely there is mercy and good counsel in it for those who believe.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ كَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَكُمْ شَهِیْدًا١ۚ یَعْلَمُ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بِالْبَاطِلِ وَ كَفَرُوْا بِاللّٰهِ١ۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say (O Prophet): “Allah suffices as a witness between me and you. He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth. As for those who believe in falsehood and are engaged in infidelity with Allah, it is they who will be the losers.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ١ؕ وَ لَوْ لَاۤ اَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى لَّجَآءَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ١ؕ وَ لَیَاْتِیَنَّهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَّ هُمْ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They ask you to hasten in bringing chastisement upon them. Had there not been an appointed term for it, the chastisement would have already visited them; in fact it will come down upon them all of a sudden (at its appointed time) while they will not be aware of it.

ayahs.arabicText: یَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِیْطَةٌۢ بِالْكٰفِرِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They ask you to hasten the chastisement upon them although Hell encompasses the unbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یَغْشٰىهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَ مِنْ تَحْتِ اَرْجُلِهِمْ وَ یَقُوْلُ ذُوْقُوْا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (They will become aware of it) the Day when the chastisement will overwhelm them from above and from under their feet, and He will say to them: “Taste now the consequence of the deeds that you used to commit.”

ayahs.arabicText: یٰعِبَادِیَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اِنَّ اَرْضِیْ وَاسِعَةٌ فَاِیَّایَ فَاعْبُدُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: O My servants who believe, verily My earth is vast; so serve Me alone.

ayahs.arabicText: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ١۫ ثُمَّ اِلَیْنَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Every being shall taste death, then it is to Us that you shall be sent back.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا١ؕ نِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعٰمِلِیْنَۗۖ
ayahs.translation: We shall house those who believed and acted righteously in the lofty mansions of Paradise beneath which rivers flow. There they shall remain for ever. How excellent a reward it is for those who acted (in obedience to Allah),

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ صَبَرُوْا وَ عَلٰى رَبِّهِمْ یَتَوَكَّلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: who remained steadfast and put their trust in their Lord!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَاَیِّنْ مِّنْ دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا١ۗۖ اَللّٰهُ یَرْزُقُهَا وَ اِیَّاكُمْ١ۖ٘ وَ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْعَلِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: How many an animal there is that does not carry about its sustenance. Allah provides sustenance to them and to you. He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ سَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَ الْقَمَرَ لَیَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ١ۚ فَاَنّٰى یُؤْفَكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: If you were to ask them: “Who created the heavens and the earth and Who has kept the sun and the moon in subjection?” they will certainly say: “Allah.” How come, then, they are being deluded from the Truth?

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ یَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ یَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ وَ یَقْدِرُ لَهٗ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Allah enlarges the sustenance of any of His servants whom He will, and straitens the sustenance of whom He will. Surely Allah has knowledge of everything.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ نَّزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَحْیَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَیَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ١ؕ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ١ؕ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا یَعْقِلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: If you were to ask them: “Who sent down water from the sky and therewith revived the earth after its death?” they will certainly say: “Allah.” Say: “To Allah alone be praise and thanks.” But most people do not understand.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا هٰذِهِ الْحَیٰوةُ الدُّنْیَاۤ اِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَّ لَعِبٌ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ الدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ لَهِیَ الْحَیَوَانُ١ۘ لَوْ كَانُوْا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The present life is nothing but sport and amusement. The true life is in the Abode of the Hereafter; if only they knew.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا رَكِبُوْا فِی الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا اللّٰهَ مُخْلِصِیْنَ لَهُ الدِّیْنَ١ۚ۬ فَلَمَّا نَجّٰىهُمْ اِلَى الْبَرِّ اِذَا هُمْ یُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: When they embark in the ships they call upon Allah, consecrating their faith to Him. But when He rescues them and brings them to land, they suddenly begin to associate others with Allah in His Divinity

ayahs.arabicText: لِیَكْفُرُوْا بِمَاۤ اٰتَیْنٰهُمْ١ۙۚ وَ لِیَتَمَتَّعُوْا١ٙ فَسَوْفَ یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: that they may be ungrateful for the rescue that We granted them, and that they may revel in the pleasures (of the present life). Soon they shall come to know.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا اَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَّ یُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ١ؕ اَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ یُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَ بِنِعْمَةِ اللّٰهِ یَكْفُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that We have given them a sanctuary of safety whereas people around them are being snatched away? So, do they believe in falsehood and ungratefully deny Allah's bounties?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوْ كَذَّبَ بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهٗ١ؕ اَلَیْسَ فِیْ جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who can be more unjust than he who foists a lie on Allah or gives the lie to the Truth after it has come to him? Is Hell not the resort of the unbelievers?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ جَاهَدُوْا فِیْنَا لَنَهْدِیَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا١ؕ وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: As for those who strive in Our cause, We shall surely guide them to Our Ways. Indeed Allah is with those who do good.
